about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed — Mass II” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, that the souls of Your servants and handmaids, cleansed by these sacrifices, may obtain both forgiveness and eternal rest. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
